messages:
nora_sre: Postmortem follow-up: capture concrete owners for GPU headroom, quota, and autoscaler tuning. Keeping this thread as the tracker.

ashley_platform: I'll run the staggered warmup + conservative scaleDown test on staging today. Plan: targetUtil=0.73, preWarm=1, scaleDownDelay=80s.

devon_scheduler: I'll file the quota request for dedicated eu-west (+4 GPUs staged). Draft PR by Tue.

maria_capacity: I'll run headroom sims including 03:00 UTC batch bursts and partner syncs. Deliver CSV + recommendation by Mon EOD.

ben_oncall: Ops will add a one-page emergency scale playbook and a Slack workflow to kick a warmup job. ETA: tomorrow.

priya_finance: Please include estimated monthly delta in the PR so finance can sign off quickly.

infra-bot: Created INF-5100: "GPU headroom sim" (owner: maria_capacity) | due 2024-07-08

nora_sre: Agreed owners/dates: scheduler tests @ashley_platform due 2024-07-10, quota PR @devon_scheduler due 2024-07-12, headroom sim @maria_capacity due 2024-07-08, ops playbook @ben_oncall due 2024-07-07.

ashley_platform: Canary plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 36h. Health gates: 99th latency regression <6%, errors <0.5%. Will post canary link.

devon_scheduler: PR will include staged quota handout and alerting for headroom <20%. Tagging @priya_finance in PR.

maria_capacity: Early sim note: batch spikes produce short tails; adding 1 pre-warm GPU reduces 95/99 tail significantly. Full CSV: https://internal/reports/headroom-22501.csv

ben_oncall: Playbook snippet added to ops-playbooks. Manual emergency command: `kubectl scale deploy inference --replicas=12 -n redwood` and warmup job: `/ops/warmup start --pool=dedi-eu-west --units=2`. Slack shortcut added.

nora_sre: Two next steps: (1) Maria to test schedule shift (move batch to 05:00 UTC) and report impact; (2) Devon to include rollback & finance numbers in PR. Recheck here in 5 days.

ashley_platform: I'll include batch-deprioritization rule in the scheduler ticket.

priya_finance: Will review cost numbers once attached; fast-track possible if schedule shift reduces steady spend.

infra-bot: Created INF-5101: "Quota PR review" (owner: devon_scheduler) | due 2024-07-12

nora_sre: Thanks team. Paste canary logs, PR links, and the headroom CSV in this thread for the follow-up meeting.
